title: The Air Gets Nothing Back
logline: Behind a house in coconut smallholding country, a few dozen open cement tanks and a shed of glass tanks are held in life by one electric blower: air goes up a pipe, along a plastic ring main and down a tube and a stone into every tank, live food is grown in a green pond at the edge of the plot and given out by the cupful four times a day, and nothing in the arrangement can be stored, so that when the power fails at two in the afternoon the margin is counted in minutes.
human_question: If a thing goes on only because something keeps arriving, what does the thing give back to what arrives?

place.what_kind_of_place: Low coconut country between a main northward road and a lagoon coast, an hour out of the capital, where garden plots of twenty or thirty perches behind ordinary houses have been given over to breeding aquarium fish for export. On one such plot: rows of open cement tanks the size of a bathtub, two and a half metres by a little over one, knee-deep, under black shade net on a frame of poles; a shed of glass tanks on timber racks, tier above tier; a dug well and a plastic overhead tank; and a blower house the size of a cupboard holding one electric air blower and, if the place can afford it, a second one standing beside it. From the blower a pipe goes up the wall into a ring main of white PVC carried over the rows on wire, drilled and tapped every half metre, and from each tap a length of soft tube drops into a tank with a weighted diffuser on the end of it. There is no other machinery. At the edge of the plot is a shallow green pond of live food, water thick with fleas, and beside it a bucket, a fine cloth net and a cane sieve. In a back room there is a table, a roll of polythene, rubber bands, foam boxes and an oxygen cylinder. Most of the stock is fancy guppies, which are most of what this country sends out; the international airport is within a half hour's drive, and everything on the plot is arranged around that. The water in the tanks is not going anywhere. It was drawn from the well once, it is siphoned and topped up, and it is not being carried, treated or delivered to anybody. What has to keep arriving is air, and what has to keep arriving is food, and neither of them can be put by.
place.why_it_is_worth_watching: Because the whole argument is one length of pipe, and the pipe is visible from end to end in a single slow move: a blower in a cupboard, a pipe up a wall, a ring main over the rows, a tap, a tube, a stone, bubbles, gills. Follow it back the other way and nothing whatever is travelling on it. The fish do not aerate the water and the water does not drive the blower; the whole place is an ordered, one-directional supply with no reciprocity anywhere in it, which is exactly the correction this group needs. And the margin is filmable in a way almost nothing is: when the grid fails, every surface in the place goes flat within a second and the sound of the farm stops, and a man is walking fast before he has thought about it. The place is beautiful before it means anything: black water under shade net with light coming through in coins, a tank of fry turning together, the guppies' colour at close range, a green pond at dawn with a cloth net drawn through it, and, at night, a table lit from below with bags of fish standing on it. The one shot that says everything is the tap on the ring main being opened a quarter turn, with a row of tanks below it and a hand that does not need to look.
place.what_moves_or_changes: The air, which is either arriving or not, and which is adjusted tap by tap through the day rather than set once. The heat, which rises in the afternoon and takes the water's capacity to hold air down with it. The live-food pond, which thickens and thins and has to be thick again tomorrow. The fry, which are the same age and the same water and visibly unequal in size. The counting, which happens at every stage and is written down. The water level as tanks are siphoned and topped up. The feed, which is given four times and then, the day before a shipment, deliberately not given at all. The temperature of the packing water, brought down by hours. And the grid, which fails without notice, so that the second blower and the generator are either there or the day is lost.
place.when_it_looks_best: The hot months in the first part of the year, when the afternoons are hardest on a shallow tank and the grid is at its worst, so that the film's central fact is present rather than described. Within a day the film wants three windows: the hour after first light, when the live-food pond is netted and the first feed goes out; the hottest hour of the afternoon, when the arrangement is under real pressure; and the night before a flight, when the fish are bagged. It wants a full week rather than a day, because the subject is repetition and an interruption that cannot be scheduled.

two_layers.without_the_philosophy: A complete, quiet film about a trade almost nobody has seen, carried on in back gardens an hour from the capital: black water under shade net, tier on tier of glass tanks, a blower in a cupboard, a ring main with a hundred taps, a green pond netted at dawn, fry crowding a cupful of water fleas, a magnifying lamp over one fish, colour at close range, a power cut and the silence it makes, a second blower started by hand, a table at night with bags standing on it and a cylinder beside them. It has its own shape with nothing said over it: air, food, counting, packing, and the hours the last bag has.
two_layers.with_the_philosophy: The same week becomes the sources' account of nutriment, which is their name for help given by something that has to keep arriving rather than help given once, and which they define as a cause that especially brings about the arising and the continuing of the mind and matter of one continuity. Laid over a plot like this it stops being a figure of speech, because the supply is a measurable quantity of air and a bucket of live food and there is no store of either. And the film uses the same sources to refuse the reading its own group's title invites. Mutual support, two things holding each other up in one moment, is a single item on a list of twenty-four, and the commentary says outright that much of what arises together does not support back. Nothing comes back along this pipe. Order and direction, not a web.

sequence.on_screen: First light in coconut smallholding country. Behind a house, under black shade net, rows of open cement tanks, each with one stream of bubbles breaking the surface. Then a shed of glass tanks on timber racks, each with its own tube and stone. Nothing human in frame. The sound is entirely air.
sequence.voice: Nothing here is being delivered anywhere. This water came out of a well once and it is not going anywhere; the fish in it were born in it. What has to arrive, and arrive again within the hour, is air. The old analysis has a name for that kind of help. The word it uses means simply a cause that brings about a result, and out of all causes four are given this name because they especially bring about the arising and the continuing of the mind and the matter of one continuity [C075-M:L128; C075-P:L411].

sequence.on_screen: Seven in the morning at the edge of the plot: a shallow green pond, its water thick with fleas, a fine cloth net drawn through it and the catch rinsed into a bucket. The bucket carried along the rows. A cupful into a tank of fry, and the fry coming up through it. Then the pond again, thinner than it was.
sequence.voice: The first of the four is the plainest. It is the nutritive essence in what is eaten and drunk. The text says it produces the matter that food makes, and holds up the continuing and the growing of matter that something else began, and then gives the consequence without softening it: a being that stops receiving it grows weak by degrees and dies [C075-P:L418–L424]. There is no store of this on the place. The pond has to be thick enough again tomorrow, and what went into the tanks this morning was started days ago.

sequence.on_screen: Midday. A thermometer in a tank. The shade net's shadow moving across water. A hand opening a tap on the ring main a quarter turn so that one row gets more, without the eyes leaving the tank. A notebook: stock counted, feeds given, deaths counted.
sequence.voice: The long list of twenty-four conditions has the same item in it, and defines it as what helps a being's mind and matter to arise again and again, to grow through a succession, and to continue unbroken [C082-P:L6843–L6850]. Then it makes the physical claim flatly: the continuity of that matter has to receive the help of the weather and of food, and if it does not, the being dies [C082-P:L6866]. It also splits the essence into an outer one and an inner one, and says that from the point where what is eaten has entered the body the two of them keep the body up together [C082-P:L6868–L6872]. On this plot that is not a metaphor. What is in the pond and what is in the bag of pellets is outside, and then it is not.

sequence.on_screen: One slow move along the whole length of the supply: the blower in its cupboard, the pipe up the wall, the ring main on wires over the rows, a tap, a soft tube, a weighted stone, bubbles, and a fish's gills working. Then the same path travelled the other way, with nothing on it.
sequence.voice: This film sits in a group whose title can be read as a slogan, so here is the correction in the sources' own words. Mutual support, two things holding each other up in the same moment, is one item on a list of twenty-four, and the commentary is blunt that not everything which arises together supports back: matter produced by the mind does not return the support it was given [C082-P:L3346]. It then lists the states that never receive this kind of help at all, by name [C082-P:L3350–L3408]. Dependence has the same shape: the great elements are a footing for derived matter, and derived matter is not a footing for derived matter [C082-P:L3616–L3620]. Many of these relations run one way only. Nothing comes back along this pipe.

sequence.on_screen: Six in the morning. A net lifted out with one dead fish in it, and the tank going on exactly as it was. Then a tank of fry of one age in one water, visibly unequal in size. A magnifying lamp brought over a single fish.
sequence.voice: Among the twenty-two faculties these books list, one is the faculty of life. They say it governs the states that arise with it, and that where it is absent there is no living at all [C075-P:L278; C075-M:L59]. But governing in this vocabulary is far narrower than ours. A faculty brings the states that arise with it into line with itself, and only inside its own function [C075-M:L39]. Their own example is an eye: a sharp faculty gives clear seeing and a weak one unclear [C075-P:L240], and a defect in it makes a thing look smaller, or larger, or a different colour, because the seeing cannot exceed what the faculty allows [C075-M:L41]. The comparison with a blower and a row of taps is ours and not the text's. What the text is refusing is the belief that the work is being done by somebody inside, and the commentary says so outright: the faculties were taught to get people out of that idea [C075-M:L91].

sequence.on_screen: The grid fails. Every surface in the place goes flat within a second and the sound of the farm stops. Feet on gravel. A second blower started by hand, or a generator pulled over, and the bubbles coming back row by row. Then the notebook, and a time written in it.
sequence.voice: Two more of the twenty-four are made of exactly this. A thing supports another by being there while it is there; the list counts seven kinds of that, and two of the seven are in this frame, because food supports the body by being present and the faculty of life supports kamma-born matter by being present [C082-P:L8230–L8234; C082-P:L8644–L8652]. The same passage keeps the idea cold. A present eye, enjoyed, is equally the support of craving, of views and of agitation [C082-P:L8712–L8722]. This is not a warm thought about being there for people. It is a statement about what has to be in existence for something else to happen at all.

sequence.on_screen: The day before a shipment. The feed not given, the tanks siphoned and topped up, a thermometer coming down over hours. Fish brought to one end of a tank with a screen and counted into a bowl, twenty at a time, by a person who does not count out loud.
sequence.voice: And then, for a day, the same supply is deliberately withheld, so that what travels in the water is not what the fish would have put into it. The texts name four nutriments [C075-P:L413–L416] and are careful that only the first of them is material, the other three being immaterial [C075-M:L138]. That care matters here, because those other three are not a programme for feeding yourself well. They are part of an account of how the round of births keeps being fed, written by people whose whole interest was in its ending.

sequence.on_screen: Night. A table lit from below. Fish counted into a polythene bag, water to a third, the rest of the bag filled from a cylinder, the neck twisted and banded, the bag set inside a second bag and then into a foam box. The lid going on. A van outside with its engine running.
sequence.voice: What goes into the top two thirds of that bag is a measured quantity of the one thing this whole place runs on, and it is measured in hours. Not days. Everything the sources say about this kind of support is in that arithmetic: help that cannot be given once, that has to arrive again, and that is here being handed over in a counted amount with an end to it [C075-M:L128; C075-P:L411].

sequence.on_screen: Before light again. The rows: shade net, black water, one stream of bubbles in each tank, the ring main above them. Nothing else in the frame. No commentary over the final half minute.
sequence.voice: One correction before we leave. None of this is the claim that everything is connected. The method in these books is a question rather than a picture, and the question is in what way, exactly, does this help: one and the same thing can help one thing as its root and another as its object, or as a footing, or as a strong support [C082-P:L97]. And every kind of support is written down with a third list beside it, of the states it does not reach [C082-P:L101]. An ordered account, with directions and exclusions in it. Nobody's life has been explained here, and nobody's hardship has been on screen.

concept_merge.why_together: C075 supplies the film and C082 supplies its frame and its limits. The digest of C075 defines nutriment as a cause that especially brings about the arising and the continuance of the mind and matter of one continuity [C075-M:L128; C075-P:L411], names the four [C075-P:L413–L416], counts only the first as material [C075-M:L138], and says of that first one that it produces food-born matter, holds up the continuing and the growing of matter that something else began, and that a being which stops receiving it weakens and dies [C075-P:L418–L424]. From the same digest's list of faculties the film takes the faculty of life, which governs the states arising with it and in whose absence there is no living [C075-P:L278; C075-M:L59], and the definition of governing itself, which is bringing associated states into line with oneself within one's own function only [C075-M:L39], with the source's own eye example, sharp faculty and clear seeing, weak faculty and unclear [C075-P:L240], and a defect making a thing look smaller, larger or differently coloured because seeing cannot exceed the faculty [C075-M:L41]; and finally the commentary's own reason for teaching the faculties at all, which is to get people out of the belief that something inside is doing the work [C075-M:L91]. C082 then holds the film to an ordered account. It gives nutriment as one of the twenty-four, help towards arising again and again, growth in succession and unbroken continuance [C082-P:L6843–L6850], with the blunt clause that the continuity of kamma-born matter must receive the help of weather and food or the being dies [C082-P:L6866], and the outer and inner essence maintaining the body together from the moment food is inside it [C082-P:L6868–L6872]. It gives presence, help by existing while one exists, in seven kinds, two of which are food and the life faculty [C082-P:L8230–L8234; C082-P:L8644–L8652], with its own counter-example keeping presence technical rather than tender [C082-P:L8712–L8722]. And it supplies the limit that this group cannot do without: mutuality is one relation among twenty-four, and not everything which arises together supports back [C082-P:L3346], with the excluded states listed [C082-P:L3350–L3408] and dependence running one way in the same manner [C082-P:L3616–L3620]. A back-garden fish farm is where those claims can be filmed with no person's circumstances in the frame: one blower, one pipe, one direction, a quantity of air and a bucket of live food, and a margin measured in minutes.
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: That 'support' in these sources is a rate and a direction rather than a bond, and that the difference shows the moment the supply is interrupted. Nothing about this place changes when the power fails: the tanks, the water, the fish and the pipe are exactly what they were. What stops is an arrival, and within minutes that is the only fact in the building. Filmed this way the sources' hardest physical sentence, that the continuity of a body must keep receiving food and weather or the being dies, is neither softened into wellness nor inflated into ecology; it is a quantity of air in the top two thirds of a polythene bag, counted in hours. And the same subject carries the group's correction without a caveat, because the supply here is unmistakably one-way: the fish do not aerate the water, the water does not drive the blower, and the pipe can be followed in both directions to prove it. Two things were dropped to get here. The previous version of this idea filmed a run-of-river power station given less water than it was built for, which duplicated two siblings in the same batch, one on a town's water supply and one on a hydro machine hall, and left four films in the slate about water taken from a river and delivered somewhere; water conveyance, hydro power and water supply are gone from this film entirely. And the version before that filmed the households of a working community through a long wet stretch and watched sharing narrow and tempers shorten, which is the one thing this group's sources forbid, real people's hardship offered as a demonstration that conditions shape conduct; that subject remains dropped and nothing of it has come back.

concept_links.why: The roles have been reassigned, and this digest is now the primary one, for two reasons. The first is that the film is made of this digest's fourth and seventh lists and of nothing else: nutriment defined as a cause that especially brings about the arising and the continuance of the mind and matter of one continuity [C075-M:L128; C075-P:L411]; the four named [C075-P:L413–L416] with only the first counted as material [C075-M:L138]; the first one's own account, food-born matter produced, the other kinds' continuity and growth held up, and death by degrees where it is not received [C075-P:L418–L424]; the faculty of life governing what arises with it, with no living in its absence [C075-P:L278; C075-M:L59]; governance defined as bringing associated states into line with oneself within one's own function [C075-M:L39], with the eye as the source's worked example [C075-P:L240; C075-M:L41]; and the commentary's statement that the faculties were taught to undo the belief in someone inside doing the work [C075-M:L91]. The second reason is that C082 is already primary on three other ideas in this group, and on the reading the digests support this film is a nutriment film with an ordered-conditions frame rather than a conditions film with a nutriment illustration. The digest's limits are kept and two of them are spoken. The faculties are not willpower or self-mastery: the fifth beat says in as many words that the comparison with a blower and a row of taps belongs to the film and not to the text, and says what the text is refusing. Nutriment is not a wellness idea: the seventh beat says that the three immaterial nutriments belong to an account of how the round keeps being fed, by people whose interest was its ending. And the digest's hardest warning is honoured by construction, because the Pradeepika's tree simile, which ties good roots in a past life to wealth and honour and says a person of weak merit may live as a servant with barely enough to eat, is nowhere in this film and could not be: there is no household, no income, no one's living conditions and no one's shortage anywhere in it. The roots, the absorption factors, the path factors, the powers and the dominants are unused. The feeling faculties, the two sex faculties and the Margaya's remarks about men's and women's thoughts are unused, as is the eight-root rebirth of great beings. The rice-seedling and bird's-beak similes and the contact and consciousness nutriments are not narrated here beyond the bare fact that three of the four are immaterial, so that this film does not restate a sibling's beats.

Now supporting rather than primary, and used for four things only. First, the nutriment condition as this digest gives it: help towards arising again and again, growth in succession and unbroken continuance [C082-P:L6843–L6850], with the clause that the continuity of kamma-born matter must receive the help of weather and food or the being dies [C082-P:L6866], and with the outer and the inner essence maintaining the body together once what is eaten is inside it [C082-P:L6868–L6872]. Second, the presence condition, help given by a thing existing while it exists, counted in seven kinds, two of which are food to the body and the life faculty to kamma-born matter [C082-P:L8230–L8234; C082-P:L8644–L8652]. Third, and this is why the idea needs this digest at all, the limit on mutuality: mutual support is one item among twenty-four and the commentary says outright that not everything arising together supports back, mind-born matter not returning the support it was given [C082-P:L3346], with the excluded states listed by name [C082-P:L3350–L3408] and with dependence running the same single direction, the great elements a footing for derived matter and derived matter not a footing for derived matter [C082-P:L3616–L3620]. Fourth, the method, stated in the last beat as a question rather than a picture, with one thing helping different things in different modes [C082-P:L97] and with each kind of support written down beside the states it does not reach [C082-P:L101]. The digest's limits are obeyed. 'Everything is connected' is refused on screen twice, in the fourth beat and in the ninth, in the digest's own terms. The film is not offered as ecology, as a social network or as physical causation, and the match-and-box illustration is not reused here. Presence is never turned into 'just being there is a gift', which is why the digest's own counter-example about delighting in a present eye is spoken [C082-P:L8712–L8722]. The decisive-support material, including the passages that name weather, food and lodging, is deliberately not narrated in this film: a sibling carries it, and on a subject where a supply is being withheld and restored it would invite exactly the verdict reading this group's floor forbids. The absence condition is unused and is not borrowed as letting go making room for the new. Predominance, repetition, co-nascence, the object condition, the kamma and result conditions and the supernormal-knowledge examples are unused. The passages on the gravest acts and on fixed wrong view, and the material on revering one's own merit [C082-P:L1723–L1727], are not cited, narrated or alluded to. No claim is made anywhere that anybody's supply, shortage or circumstances are deserved.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: That these sources distinguish help given once from help that has to keep arriving, that they have a specific name for the second kind, and that they state its physical version without hedging: a body's continuity has to keep receiving food and weather or the being dies. And that this is not the cheerful claim that everything is connected. Mutual support is one relation on a list of twenty-four, much of what arises together does not support back, and every kind of support is set down beside the states it does not reach. Nothing is claimed about any person, and nobody's circumstances are on screen.
what_must_be_real: The place as it actually runs in the week the crew is there, including whatever is crowded, ailing, unsold or out of service. Aeration is never interrupted, reduced or restored for the camera, and a power failure is filmed only if the grid actually fails; if it does not, the film says so rather than arranging it. No fish is netted, crowded, screened, chilled, starved, counted or bagged for a shot, and the day's withholding before a shipment is filmed only if that shipment would have gone anyway. Whatever mortality is visible is filmed as it is, neither arranged, waited for, nor cut away from. The crew observes the farm's own biosecurity, changes nothing between plots and does not film at all if being admitted would put the stock at risk. The people working are filmed as people doing work, are not made into characters, and are not asked to confirm any doctrine. The trade's own arrangements, including what is sent where and under what certificate, are shown as they are and not improved.
position_hint: middle to late in the group: it needs the viewer to have already accepted that the sources describe specific, named kinds of support rather than a web, and it is the group's plainest demonstration that a named kind of support runs in one direction only, so it sits after the statements of what support is and beside the film about a fire that has not been let out. No location reasoning is involved.
risks: The group's own title. A film about a supply can slide into 'everything is connected', which is the one reading the sources refuse; the fourth beat and the last exist to stop it and must not be cut.
Letting the plot become a figure for a body or a mind, so that the film quietly says 'you are an arrangement like this', which the digests' limits do not support.
Turning nutriment into wellness: feed your body, feed your mind, feed your soul.
Sentimentalising the stock, or letting a dead fish lifted out in a net read as a verdict on anything.

Animals kept in numbers in small volumes for export is a real argument, and this film is neither the prosecution nor the brochure. Filming it beautifully while pretending the argument does not exist is a posture; taking a side in it is a different film. The line this one holds is the rate and direction of a supply.
Electricity supply is a live political grievance in this country. A power cut in this film is a fact about a margin, not an accusation, and equally it cannot be tidied away.
Reading the faculties as willpower or self-control, which the digest explicitly refuses; the fifth beat names the analogy as the film's own for that reason.
Borrowing the presence condition as a warm idea about being there for people.

Any implication that anybody's living is deserved or explained. The digest's tree simile is the exact form that error takes, and it is why there is no household, no income and nobody's circumstances in the film.
Letting an exporter's commercial interest shape what the film says about stock, mortality, species or certification.
Straying into the separate question of endemic and wild-caught species, which is a real regulatory matter and a different subject from this one.
drop_if: The farm will not permit the blower house, the open tanks, the glass-tank shed, the live-food pond and the packing table to be filmed, since the film is those five things and the pipe between them.
Biosecurity means a crew cannot be admitted to the tanks at all, which is a fair refusal and not one to negotiate around.
The only way to show the film's central fact would be to interrupt the air, or to wait for stock to die, or to have either arranged.
No shipment falls inside the filming window, so the counted quantity of air in a bag would have to be described rather than watched.
The film can only be made on terms that require it to be promotional, or that require mortality and crowding to be kept out of frame.

connections.note: Two films on support that has to keep arriving rather than support given once. That one follows a supply out of an impoundment and along fifteen kilometres of pipe to a town; this one stays inside one plot where nothing is carried anywhere and the thing that must arrive is air. Neither has a household in it.

Two working places where something has to be given again within the hour: one a fire that has not been allowed to go out, the other a few dozen tanks whose margin without air is minutes rather than hours.
One film is the list's one genuinely two-way relation, poles leaning on each other until every hand can come off; this one is the ordinary case, a supply that runs one way and receives nothing back.

selection.reason: Nutriment is the one condition in these sources that can be filmed as a quantity and a clock, and a back-garden fish farm makes it a length of pipe with a direction: a supply that cannot be stored, an interruption measured in minutes, and no person's circumstances anywhere in the frame.

review.note: Rebuilt 2026-09-24 off water conveyance entirely, to avoid duplicating IDEA-0161 and IDEA-0154. What was dropped: the run-of-river mini hydro station on a hill river, its weir, headrace channel, forebay, penstock, four Francis turbines and the rearrangement of the station through a dry month. It was dropped because it was the fourth film in the slate about water taken from a river and delivered somewhere, and because it shared both its concept pair and its shape with IDEA-0161, a stream taken, carried along a built channel, output depending on inflow. IDEA-0161 keeps the water-supply subject and IDEA-0154 keeps the hydro machine hall; hydro power, water supply and water conveyance are now absent from this film, and the older dropped subject, a working community's households filmed through a long wet stretch with sharing narrowing and tempers shortening, has not come back and must not. The new subject is a back-garden ornamental-fish breeding plot kept in life by one electric blower and a bucket of live food, where the supply cannot be stockpiled and an interruption shows in minutes. The concept roles have been reassigned, and the reassignment is the substantive editorial change here: C075 is now primary and C082 supporting. The reason is that the digests support it, since the film is built out of C075's own material, the definition of nutriment, the first nutriment and its death clause, the four with only the first material, the faculty of life, governance within one's own function with the eye example, and the commentary's statement that the faculties were taught to undo the belief in someone inside; and C082 now does what a supporting concept should do, supplying the ordered frame, the nutriment and presence conditions, and above all the limit on mutuality that this group's title makes indispensable. It also relieves a real imbalance, since C082 was primary on IDEA-0153, IDEA-0154 and IDEA-0161 as well as here. The decisive-support material, weather, food and lodging by name, has been deliberately set aside: a sibling carries it, and on a subject where a supply is withheld and restored it would invite the verdict reading this group's floor forbids. Both digests were re-read and every citation re-tested against digest evidence; no citation was carried over from the previous text unchecked, and the citations that belonged to the dropped subject are gone with it.

suggested_location.name: The ornamental-fish breeding plots of the Ja-Ela, Kandana and Pamunugama belt, between the Colombo–Negombo road and the coast

also_known_as.name: aquarium fish
also_known_as.meaning: the trade's and the export authorities' usual name in this country for the same stock the world calls ornamental fish
also_known_as.used_by: exporters, the export development authority and the aquaculture authority

also_known_as.name: fancy guppy
also_known_as.meaning: the selectively bred varieties of one small live-bearing fish, which make up most of the country's freshwater export
also_known_as.used_by: breeders, exporters and the trade press

also_known_as.name: airline and air stone
also_known_as.meaning: the soft tube from a tap on the ring main and the weighted diffuser on the end of it, which together are the whole of the supply this film is about

suggested_location.region: Gampaha District, Western Province: the low coconut and marsh country between the main northward road out of the capital and the lagoon coast, within a half hour's drive of the international airport, where breeding plots stand behind ordinary houses in garden-sized holdings
suggested_location.why_here: Because this district is documented as having both the largest number of ornamental-fish farms in the country and the largest number of farmers breeding for export, so the subject exists here in ordinary back gardens rather than as a single showpiece, and a film can choose a plot small enough that the whole supply is visible in one move. The trade is real and specific: the country holds a small but steady share of a world market of a few hundred million dollars, has of the order of forty regular exporting companies and about thirty registered at the animal quarantine station, and fancy guppies alone are around two thirds of its freshwater export, going mainly to the United States, Japan and the European Union under a health certificate issued for every shipment. The proximity of the airport is the reason the belt is where it is, and it is also the reason the film's final beat exists, because the fish leave in bags holding a counted quantity of oxygen. Practically, a plot of this kind is a private commercial operation that can consent for itself, has no private grief in it, asks nobody to be an example of anything, and is entirely dependent on one piece of machinery and one supply of live food, which is the whole of what the film is about.
what_to_film: The whole supply in one continuous move: the blower in its cupboard, the pipe up the wall, the ring main over the rows, a tap, a tube, a stone, bubbles, gills.
The rows of open cement tanks under shade net at first light, with light coming through the net in coins on black water.
The glass-tank shed from the end of a rack, tier above tier, each tank with its own tube.
The live-food pond at seven in the morning: the green water, the cloth net drawn through it, the catch rinsed into a bucket, and the pond visibly thinner afterwards.
A feed going out along the rows, a cupful at a time, and fry coming up through it.
The hottest hour of the afternoon: a thermometer in a tank, a tap opened a quarter turn, and the notebook it is written in.
A power failure if one occurs: the surfaces going flat, the silence, the second blower or the generator, and the bubbles returning row by row.
A single fish under a magnifying lamp, and a tank of fry of one age that are visibly unequal in size.
The day before a shipment: no feed, tanks siphoned, the packing water's temperature coming down, fish screened to one end and counted into a bowl.
The night packing table lit from below: bags filled to a third with water and the rest from an oxygen cylinder, banded, double-bagged, boxed, and the van outside.
suggested_location.access: By road north out of the capital and then into lanes off it; the plots are behind houses and are reached on foot through a gate. Everything depends on the consent of the individual farm, and consent has two parts: permission to film and permission to enter the tank area at all, which is a biosecurity decision rather than a courtesy, since a visitor can move disease between plots. Expect footwear changes, hand and equipment disinfection, a fixed route, and a refusal to admit anyone to particular tanks. The packing room and the dispatch run are a commercial operation working to a flight, and filming there is at their convenience and not the crew's. No height is needed anywhere and a drone would be both useless and unwelcome over a residential lane. Electricity is the one thing outside anybody's control here, which is precisely why the film wants a week rather than a day.
suggested_location.best_time: The hot months of the first part of the year, when afternoon heat and grid failures are both at their worst and the margin the film is about is real rather than theoretical. Within a day: the hour after first light for the live-food harvest and the first feed; the hottest hour of the afternoon; and the evening and night before a shipment. A full working week, with the packing night identified in advance from the farm's own dispatch schedule and a day held in reserve in case the flight moves.

suggested_location.research_note: Desk research only and unverified on the ground. From the sources above: the country holds about 2.7 per cent of a world ornamental-fish market put at some 412 million US dollars, with roughly forty regular exporting companies and a large number of small and medium producers; 111 ornamental species are recorded across fresh, brackish and marine water; fancy guppies are 60 to 70 per cent of the freshwater export; the main buyers are the United States, Japan and the European Union; and a health certificate from the animal quarantine authority accompanies every shipment. A peer-reviewed survey of ornamental-fish farms selected this district because it is considered one of those with the highest number of such farms and has the highest number of farmers breeding for export; it surveyed 91 farms, starting from the 31 exporters then registered at the animal quarantine station, and found biosecurity scores ranging from 63 per cent down to 5 per cent, which is the reason access here is treated as a biosecurity question rather than a courtesy. Trade and extension material describes guppies raised in cement tanks with aeration to every tank, high-density cement-tank culture chosen to economise on land and labour, hatchlings held in cement tanks with aeration until the yolk is absorbed, live feed based on the water flea cultured in an earthen pond and cement tanks, and spawn fed partly on live feed and partly on compounded feed. One farm's own published protocol gives a 20 to 21 day nursery period, 45 days of conditioning for females and about 30 days of maturation and sorting for males, packing in expanded-polystyrene boxes with medical oxygen, and conditioning of the stock at 18 degrees for six hours before export; several exporters state that they are sited for quick access to the international airport. Four things the film depends on are inferences rather than confirmed facts: how long a particular farm's tanks actually have once aeration stops, which is the film's central number and is nowhere published; whether a chosen plot has a second blower or a generator and how often the grid there fails; whether the live-food pond rather than bought feed is still the real source on the plots that would be filmed; and whether the packing table and the dispatch run can be filmed at all given quarantine and commercial pressure. The coordinate is an approximate point in the belt between the main road and the coast, not a survey: no farm, plot, pond or blower house has been identified on the ground, and the belt is named from exporters' own stated locations and from the district-level survey rather than from any inventory of plots. Nobody has been approached and no permission has been sought from any farm, exporter or authority. The two images are contributors' photographs on Wikimedia Commons of, respectively, an evening in a village of this district and the species itself in an aquarium; neither shows this trade, and the file pages should be checked before use.

unknowns: How long a particular plot's tanks actually have once the air stops, in the afternoon and at night, which is the number the whole film rests on and which no published source gives.
Whether a farm small enough to film whole has a second blower, a generator, or neither, and how often the grid fails where it stands.
Whether a farm will admit a crew to the tank area at all, given that a visitor is a disease risk, and on what disinfection terms.
Whether the live-food pond is still the real source of first feed on the plots that would be filmed, or whether it has been replaced by bought feed.
Whether the packing table, the oxygen and the dispatch run can be filmed given quarantine requirements and the pressure of a flight.
Whether a grid failure will actually occur inside the filming window, and what the film does if it does not.
Whether the film can stay on the rate and direction of a supply without being drawn into the separate arguments about keeping animals in numbers and about wild-caught and endemic species.
evidence_class_note: Editorial proposal. The location is proposed by Claude from desk research and is unverified. No scene or shot is decided here.
